test_action_scale_wrapper_step: test the action_scale.Wrapper step method scales actions between minimum and maximum bounds correctly
test_action_scale_correct_spec: test the action_scale.Wrapper returns an action_spec with the correct minimum and maximum bounds
test_action_scale_method_delegation: test the action_scale.Wrapper delegates reset, observation_spec, and control_timestep to the underlying env
test_action_scale_invalid_spec_type: test the action_scale.Wrapper raises ValueError when the action_spec is not a BoundedArray
test_action_scale_non_finite_bounds: test the action_scale.Wrapper raises ValueError when minimum or maximum bounds contain NaN or infinity
